test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 15 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
In this question, a statement is followed by two conclusions. Which of the two conclusions is/are true with respect to the statement? 

Statement:

N J I = H ≤ G

Conclusion:

I. J = G

II. K > H

options.text: Both conclusions I and II are true
Neither conclusion I nor II is true

solution:
Given Statement:

N J I = H ≤ G

Conclusion:

I) J = G → False (As J I = H ≤ G → no clear relation between J and G can be determined)

II) K > H → True (As K > I = H → There is the relation between K and H can be determined)

Hence, the correct answer is** "Only conclusion II is true "**.
